brand_identity.name: THE VIBE CURATOR
brand_identity.positioning: Experiential Design Consultancy — Theatrical & Tactile Editorial Case Studies
brand_identity.aesthetic_direction: Deep burgundy moody luxury, warm candlelit ambient tones, tactile materials, slow editorial storytelling, zero corporate agency tropes

bard_hero.description: Alonso Sánchez Coello (1579) 'The Royal Feast' - Public domain 16th-century painting depicting an authentic Elizabethan/Tudor court banquet with long dining tables, period dress, and timber architecture.
Dirck Hals (1628) 'Banquet Scene in a Renaissance Hall' - Public domain period painting showing a grand banqueting hall feast with musicians, actors, and guests sharing a period meal.

bard_theatre.description: Public domain photograph of the interior thrust stage, wooden galleries, and open-air yard of Shakespeare's Globe Theatre in London.
Public domain illustration depicting an Elizabethan playhouse performance with actors on stage and balcony seating.

bard_table.description: Warm candlelight illuminating dark timber dining table with rustic period style vessel and dark shadows.
Silver pewter-like chalice and rustic bread on heavy dark timber under warm flickering candle light.

bard_candle.description: Flickering taper candle glow casting warm shadows on dark timber.
Multiple lit taper candles on dark background providing period banqueting ambience.

bard_textile.description: Intricate floral and foliage tapestry texture with deep amber, brown, and ochre woven threads.
Antique woven textile with rich dark green and earthy forest motifs.

bard_hall.description: Public domain historical engraving/view of Henry VIII's Great Hall at Hampton Court Palace with hammerbeam timber roof and wall tapestries.
Public domain interior photograph of the Tudor Great Hall at Hampton Court Palace showing high timber arches and long carved tables.

wool_hero.description: Close-up macro of dark draped wrinkled cashmere wool fabric texture with warm moody light, completely fabric-focused with NO people.
Detailed macro view of gray knitted woolen fabric showing rich tactile weave and folds, NO people.

wool_texture.description: Macro close-up of blue/gray textured wool knit showing individual loops and soft fibers.
Close-up of traditional weaving loom with wooden shuttle and taut warp threads.

wool_drape.description: Rich dark draped textured wool textile in moody deep tones with dramatic folds.
Soft folded wool textile close-up showing warm light and subtle shadow lines.

layout_pacing_advice: To achieve a truly immersive editorial experience, alternate wide cinematic hero stills with intimate asymmetrical macro crops in a generous grid. Intersperse narrative text passages in Cormorant Garamond serif with full-bleed atmospheric imagery, ensuring high contrast using gold (#C5A059) and cream (#FDFBF7) typography over deep burgundy (#3B0C11) backdrops.
